provenance: Original Kingdom Come reconstruction, not recovered Storm8 formulas. Phase 4.3 shared hourly estate cycles, bounty-only casualty statistics, level-aware victory XP and development allies.

victoryXp.defendingVictories: Real player defensive victories use the same level-aware formula and a separate three-full-victories-per-pair daily budget, then 1 XP. Passive NPCs do not gain XP or move from their assigned level. Defensive level-ups preserve post-damage Health and resources; they never revive a defeated bounty target.

income.policy: One persistent character-wide hourly boundary. New purchases earn only their actual time to the next boundary. Sub-gold accrual is carried with integer numerators. Existing holding cursors and historical settlements are preserved. Equipment upkeep remains continuously accrued, using prepaid reserves before carried gold.

recruitment.botAcceptance: Development-only immediate acceptance; one contribution to each human roster, never to the passive bot roster.

statistics.deaths: Completed bounty claims against this character only
